axes: row = north ascending, col = east ascending; value at cell centre
source: Sea breeze: Ojai Valley daytime westerly onshore winds (Ojai REC climatology appendix, DocumentCenter/View/1464, 1988-89 wind rose). Santa Ana: NWS Southern California Santa Ana — northeast offshore flow.
what: exposure to afternoon sea breeze from W
decode: if pixel == 65535: nodata; else value = value_min + (pixel / 65534) * (value_max - value_min)
axes_npz: row = north ascending (south at index 0), col = east ascending
